channel.title: Harico Estates — Official Real Estate & New Launch Updates
channel.description: Official updates, floor plans, pricing, and MahaRERA milestones for Harico Diwaam (Kiwale) and Harico Edge (Punawale) by Sentosa Developers.

item.title: Mega Launch: Harico Diwaam Kiwale — Tallest 24-Storey Towers Opposite Sentosa
item.description: Harico Diwaam in Kiwale Ravet features 5 iconic 24-storey sky towers across 5 acres starting ₹70.00 Lacs* (3 BHK from ₹89.90 Lacs*). 100+ resort amenities. MahaRERA PR1260002502389.

item.title: Harico Edge Punawale — Ultra-Luxury 2 & 3 BHK Homes near Bhumkar Chowk
item.description: Harico Edge offers spacious 2 & 3 BHK luxury flats with dual private balconies starting ₹74.00 Lacs* near Expressway & 12 mins to Hinjewadi IT Park. MahaRERA P52100031773.

item.title: Harico Pride Punawale — Expansive Usable Carpets & Rooftop Pool
item.description: Harico Pride near Bhiku Vallabh Kale School offers 2 & 3 BHK homes with largest carpets from ₹78.00 Lacs*. MahaRERA P52100018471.
